Nina: ok tiny experiment — pick a book scene that feels like a song, and drop the book line + the one song you'd press play on to teleport there.

Nina: "We were somewhere around Barstow on the edge of the desert..." — Hunter S. Thompson, Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas. song: 'White Room' — Cream. desert/noise roadtrip energy :desert_island:

Alex: Love this. mine: "She had been dead for forty years and then there she was..." — Gabriel Garcia Marquez, One Hundred Years of Solitude. song: 'A Forest' — The Cure. magical, humid, cyclical vibes :leaves:

Priya: okay my soft option: "There is no greater agony than bearing an untold story inside you." — Maya Angelou. song: 'River' — Joni Mitchell. feels like quiet confession by a kitchen table :candle:

Leo: mine's silly but specific: "He was one of those men who reach their right hand out, not because they mean to steal, but because they simply don't remember which pocket the cigarette is in." — Raymond Chandler. song: 'I'm Not in Love' — 10cc. smoky diner noir :cigarette: :coffee:

Nina: @Alex OMG that Marquez line paired w/ The Cure is perfect. adding it to my 'strange summers' playlist.

MusicBot: added 4 songs to 'Redwood - Scene Songs' collaborative playlist.

Alex: quick poll — which pairing should be on the "office sleepy commute" auto-shuffle? React with :one: Nina, :two: Alex, :three: Priya, :four: Leo

Priya: :three:

Leo: :four: (for the drama)

Nina: :one: (guilty pleasure road vibes)

Alex: tie! will rotate them. also if anyone has a tiny quote + 1 song for a 2-minute read at lunchtime send it here.

Priya: thanks y'all, low-key loved this break. feels like book club but faster :sparkles:

Nina: same — we should do a thematic round next week (train stations, city summers, breakup lines)

Leo: count me in. maybe 'train stations + ambient techno' night :train:
